mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_roots ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, scenario TEXT NOT NULL, source_version TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), active_limit_seconds INTEGER, closing_active_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (closing_active_seconds >= 0), closing_run_id TEXT, phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUSINESS' CHECK (phase IN ('BUSINESS','CLOSING')), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,root_id), UNIQUE (tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode), CHECK ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND active_limit_seconds IS NOT NULL AND active_limit_seconds>0) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND active_limit_seconds IS NULL)) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_runs ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('PRIMARY','MEMBER')), source_version TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), active_limit_seconds INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_roots(tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode), CHECK ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND active_limit_seconds IS NOT NULL AND active_limit_seconds>0) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND active_limit_seconds IS NULL)) ) STRICT
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_runs_root ON agent_runtime_budget_runs(tenant_id,root_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_balances ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('ROOT','RUN','STAGE_BASE','STAGE','CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN')), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, dimension TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), maximum INTEGER CHECK (maximum >= 0), consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consumed >= 0), reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reserved >= 0), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,scope_kind,scope_id,dimension), CHECK ((scope_kind IN ('CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN') AND maximum IS NOT NULL) OR (scope_kind NOT IN ('CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN') AND ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND maximum IS NOT NULL) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND maximum IS NULL)))) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_attempts ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, closing INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closing IN (0,1)), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('RESERVED','SENT','RESULT_SAVED','SETTLED')), result_reference TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_runs(tenant_id,run_id) ) STRICT
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_attempts_recovery ON agent_runtime_budget_attempts(tenant_id,run_id,state)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_result_receipts ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, result_reference TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id,result_reference), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_attempts(tenant_id,attempt_id) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_closing_targets ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_handle TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id,target_handle), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_runs(tenant_id,run_id) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, dimension TEXT NOT NULL, reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reserved >= 0), reported INTEGER CHECK (reported >= 0), settled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (settled IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id,dimension), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,attempt_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_attempts(tenant_id,attempt_id) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runtime_budget_activity ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, interval_id TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, confirmed_through TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (confirmed_through >= started_at), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id,interval_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_runs(tenant_id,run_id) ) STRICT
